name: Oh Daddy
source: Here you will have to make decisions during the summer vacations in the mountain house. Having a good student means giving her a lot of whims and accepting what she wants. But be careful the mountains have some mysterious places and it would be very easy to get lost.​
translation: 在这里，你必须在暑假期间在山屋里做出决定。拥有一个好学生意味着给她很多想法并接受她想要的东西。但要小心，山上有一些神秘的地方，很容易迷路。​
